scope: Core calls including validation, minimum palette, seed preparation, copying, allocation and output construction. Standalone repair borrows the same original baseline constructed outside timing. Fixtures, independent checks, quality, allocation measurement and output destruction outside timing.
memory: Separate untimed requested-live-heap peak and allocation count; includes returned output, excludes caller inputs, allocator overhead, stack and RSS. Allocator hooks compiled into timed binary with tracking disabled.
quality: Once per fixture/method/budget, separate CSV; individual forward/backward losses retained. Only bound-attained optima are certified in core fixtures; otherwise unknown.
multiseed: Benchmark-only experiment sharing one budget across baseline/forward/backward repair calls; repeated production preparation included. No production algorithm copy.
derived_default_samples: Exact subset of raw samples with budget in {0,100000}; options are fixed per method; all seven methods retained; 2100 rows.
